facts.text: Every guest room has a private screened-in patio overlooking the water, with sunrise or sunset views.
facts.excerpt: Every guest room features a private screened-in patio overlooking the coastal waters, with captivating sunrise or sunset views

facts.text: The condo-style suites were originally built as waterfront residences and have full kitchens, living and dining areas and screened-in patios.
facts.excerpt: Originally built as luxury waterfront residences, our spacious condo-style suites feature full kitchens, living and dining areas, and private screened-in patios.

facts.text: The premier residence sits at the apex of the resort, with panoramic views over the marina, preserve and waterways.
facts.excerpt: Perched at the apex of the resort, this premier residence offers panoramic views spanning the marina, preserve, and surrounding waterways from sunrise to sunset.

facts.text: The resort has three outdoor pools with views of the Caloosahatchee River and the Gulf of Mexico.
facts.excerpt: Relax and enjoy our three outdoor pools with expansive views of the Caloosahatchee River and the Gulf of Mexico.

facts.text: Esterra Spa & Salon has views of Tarpon Point Marina and the Caloosahatchee River.
facts.excerpt: Complete with views of Tarpon Point Marina and the Caloosahatchee River, you'll find invigorating services designed to promote wellness and enhance your beauty.

facts.text: The spa has a couples treatment room and a Vichy shower room.
facts.excerpt: Our full-service spa in Cape Coral offers five treatment rooms including one for couples, as well as a Vichy shower room

facts.text: Guests can kayak, paddleboard or set out by boat from the marina.
facts.excerpt: Waterfront Adventures: Kayak, paddleboard, or set out by boat from our marina.

facts.text: Tarpon Point Marina, next to the resort, offers deep-water slips, transient dockage, a fuel dock and dock-and-dine access to Marina Village shops and restaurants.
facts.excerpt: Adjacent to The Westin Cape Coral Resort, Tarpon Point Marina offers deep-water slips, transient dockage, a full-service fuel dock with gas and diesel, and dock-and-dine access to Marina Village shopping and dining options.

facts.text: A tour lets guests see dolphins in their natural surroundings.
facts.excerpt: Take a 2-hour tour and visit the dolphins in their natural surroundings.

facts.text: Guests have complimentary access to outdoor clay tennis courts, bocce ball and walking and running trails at the Recreational Center.
facts.excerpt: Guests receive complimentary access to two outdoor clay tennis courts, bocce ball, and walking/running trails.

facts.text: Marker 92 Waterfront Bar & Bistro serves steaks and seafood with views of the Caloosahatchee River and Tarpon Point Marina.
facts.excerpt: Treat your taste buds to fine steaks and fresh seafood with gorgeous waterfront views of the Caloosahatchee River and Tarpon Point Marina.

facts.text: The Nauti Mermaid is a waterfront restaurant with boat access.
facts.excerpt: Experience boat-access dining near Fort Myers at The Nauti Mermaid, a Cape Coral waterfront restaurant.
Yoga overlooking the marina, guided by ReCharge Me Zone

facts.text: The hotel is less than an hour's drive from Sanibel Island.
facts.excerpt: our hotel is less than an hour's drive from Sanibel Island

facts.text: The Fill Your Fridge service lets guests pre-stock their suite with groceries before arrival.
facts.excerpt: Our Fill Your Fridge service allows you to pre-stock your suite with your favorite groceries and essentials before you arrive.

facts.text: A resort fee applies; it covers amenities such as the private clubhouse, daily yoga classes and bike rentals.
facts.excerpt: Revitalize your mind and body with the amenities included in your Resort Fee: Access to the Private Clubhouse

facts.text: The Private Recreation Area is a short walk from the resort.
facts.excerpt: A short walk from our Cape Coral resort, guests will have exclusive access to the Private Recreation Area.

facts.text: Dogs are not permitted at the resort pool.
facts.excerpt: Dogs must be leashed at all times and are not permitted at the resort pool.
